cohort: 5276 12-month-old infants who underwent skin prick testing and oral food challenge to ascertain food allergy status
finding: Caesarean delivery, either with or without labor, or elective or emergency, was not associated with the risk of food allergy in a population-based cohort of 12-month-old infants.
mod_finding: Neither caesarean delivery before the onset of labor, nor after the onset of labor, was associated with the risk of food allergy.
